parameters.method: 011 VLG (Neo-Riemannian graph walk, weighted, section cadence anchors)

notes: Raw voice-leading graph search: weighted walk over the diatonic Neo-Riemannian graph (R/L/plagal/authentic edges) generates the 28-bar chord sequence; the minimal-movement voice note + triad arpeggio is emitted as a single raw voice. Float pitch + chromatic jitter, off-grid onsets, pre-rules.
